name: create_entities
description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph. Entities that already exist (by name) are silently skipped.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name.description: The unique name of the entity

entityType.description: The type of the entity (e.g. person, organization, event)

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

attributes.description: Key-value attributes to store on the entity

name: create_relations
description: Create multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Relations should be in active voice. Relations that already exist (same from, to, relationType) are silently skipped.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the relation

attributes.description: Key-value attributes to store on the relation

name: add_observations
description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph. Observations are appended; duplicates are not removed.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

name: add_relation_observations
description: Add new observations to existing relations in the knowledge graph. Each relation is identified by its from, to, and relationType triple. Observations are appended; duplicates are not removed.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add to the relation

name: delete_relation_observations
description: Delete specific observations from relations in the knowledge graph. Each relation is identified by its from, to, and relationType triple; the observations array lists the exact observations (body and optional timestamp) to remove.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

observations.description: An array of observations to delete from the relation

name: set_attributes
description: Set or replace key-value attributes on a target entity or relation in the knowledge graph. Attributes are targeted by owner kind: an entity is addressed by entityName, a relation by its from/to/relationType triple. Each target carries the attribute map to apply; keys already present are overwritten. Target exclusivity is enforced by the handler: exactly one of entityName or from/to/relationType must be provided per target.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

ownerKind.description: The kind of the attribute owner: 'entity' or 'relation'

entityName.description: The name of the entity to set attributes on (required when ownerKind is 'entity')

from.description: The source entity name of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

to.description: The target entity name of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

relationType.description: The type of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

attributes.description: Key-value attributes to set or replace on the target

name: delete_attributes
description: Delete specific key-value attributes from a target entity or relation in the knowledge graph. Attributes are targeted by owner kind: an entity is addressed by entityName, a relation by its from/to/relationType triple. The keys array lists which attributes to remove. Target exclusivity is enforced by the handler: exactly one of entityName or from/to/relationType must be provided per target.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

ownerKind.description: The kind of the attribute owner: 'entity' or 'relation'

entityName.description: The name of the entity to delete attributes from (required when ownerKind is 'entity')

from.description: The source entity name of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

to.description: The target entity name of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

relationType.description: The type of the relation (required when ownerKind is 'relation')

keys.description: Attribute keys to delete from the target

name: delete_entities
description: Delete multiple entities and their associated relations from the knowledge graph. Relations referencing deleted entities (from either endpoint) are also removed.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

name: delete_observations
description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

name: delete_relations
description: Delete multiple relations from the knowledge graph. Each relation must match on from, to, and relationType to be deleted.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

name: read_graph
description: Read the knowledge graph. With no arguments, returns all entities and relations. Optionally filter by entityType and paginate with offset/limit; when filtered, only relations whose both endpoints fall in the returned page are included.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

entityType.description: Only return entities of this type (optional)

offset.description: Number of matching entities to skip (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return (optional)

name: search_nodes
description: Search for entities in the knowledge graph. Matches against entity names, types, and observation content (case-insensitive), returned best-match-first by relevance. Returns matching entities. Relation text is searched via search_relations. Optionally restrict by entityType and paginate with offset/limit.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

query.description: Search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

entityType.description: Only return entities of this type (optional)

offset.description: Number of ranked matches to skip (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return (optional)

name: open_nodes
description: Open specific nodes in the knowledge graph by their entity names. Returns the requested entities along with any relations connected to them (from either endpoint).

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

name: get_entity
description: Retrieve a single entity by its exact name. Returns the entity with its observations and attributes but no associated relations.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name.description: The exact name of the entity to retrieve

name: graph_stats
description: Return aggregate statistics about the knowledge graph: entity count, relation count, total observations, search index size, and interner utilization.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: search_relations
description: Search for relations by optional from/to/relationType filters and an optional full-text query. Omitted or empty fields match all values. Each returned row is a relation detail carrying its observations and attributes; the query matches against relation text.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

from.description: Filter by the source entity name (optional)

to.description: Filter by the target entity name (optional)

query.description: Full-text search query matched against relation text (optional)

name: find_path
description: Find the shortest path (via relations) between two entities using BFS. Returns the sequence of entity names connecting them.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: compact
description: Trigger storage compaction: merge segments and drop tombstoned/superseded records to reclaim space. Safe to call periodically; runs in the background.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: get_neighbors
description: Return the neighborhood of an entity: the entity plus all entities reachable within 'depth' hops, and the relations among them. Use this to expand context around a node in one call.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

direction.description: Follow outgoing (out), incoming (in), or any (both) edges. Defaults to both.

relationType.description: Only traverse/return relations of this type (optional)

name: describe_entity
description: One-shot context bundle for a single entity: the entity with its observations and attributes, every incident relation, its distinct neighbor names, and its degree. Replaces a get_entity plus two search_relations calls.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name.description: The exact name of the entity to describe

name: list_entity_types
description: List all distinct entity types present in the graph with their entity counts, ranked by count descending. Use to discover the schema of the memory before querying.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: list_relation_types
description: List all distinct relation types present in the graph with their counts, ranked by count descending.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: suggest_taxonomy
description: Suggest existing taxonomy names similar to a new name before it is created. For kind `entityType` or `relationType`, results prefer semantic similarity to the closest existing type names, with the offline string engine filling the remaining slots; use it to keep the memory schema consistent. For kind `entity` or `relation`, results come from the semantic tier (the entity ANN or the relation snapshot) when the embedding pipeline serves an index profile, and are empty otherwise.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

query.description: The name to find similar taxonomy names for (required, must not be blank)

kind.description: What kind of taxonomy entry to suggest (optional, default entityType)

topK.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return (optional, default 10)

name: set_type_description
description: Set or clear the description of one taxonomy type — an entity type (`kind: entityType`) or a relation type (`kind: relationType`). The type row is registered when it does not exist yet, so a description can document a type before its first member. Pass an empty string to clear the description. The description is registry metadata: it tags the type's meaning so later callers see what each type is for. Read it back with `list_entity_types` / `list_relation_types`, which return the `desc` field on each described type.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

kind.description: What kind of taxonomy type to describe (optional, default entityType)

name.description: The exact type name, e.g. `person` or `works_at`

description.description: The description to store; an empty string clears it (required, max 4096 bytes)

name: upsert_entities
description: Create-or-merge entities idempotently. Entities that do not exist are created; existing exact-name entities are retyped when `entityType` differs; observations are added only when new. Use this to safely re-assert facts without losing new observations.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name.description: The unique name of the entity

entityType.description: The type of the entity (applied when creating and when retyping an existing exact-name entity)

observations.description: Observations to add (new ones are merged in)

attributes.description: Key-value attributes to store on the entity

name: export_graph
description: Export the entire knowledge graph as text in the requested format: 'json' (entities and relations, including observations and attributes), 'mermaid' (a Mermaid graph diagram), or 'dot' (Graphviz DOT). Defaults to json.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: merge_entities
description: Merge source entity into target in O(S + R) time where S = source observations and R = incident relations. Uses add_observations (dedup internally via HashSet) + batch create_relations (dedup via HashSet) + delete_entities. Self-loop relations (source → source becomes target → target) are dropped automatically. All three sub-operations write to the write-ahead log, so a replay from disk reconstructs the merge exactly. Use to collapse duplicate entities the LLM accidentally created.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

source.description: Entity name to merge FROM (deleted after merge)

target.description: Entity name to merge INTO (receives observations + redirected relations)

name: rename_entity
description: Rename one entity while preserving its stable identity, observations, and all incident relations. Entity names are exact and case-sensitive; the destination name must not already exist.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name: extract_subgraph
description: BFS-based subgraph extraction from N seed nodes out to depth d. Builds adjacency map once (O(R)) then expands BFS queue (worst-case O(V + E) for the reached subgraph). Returns entities and only those relations whose both endpoints are in the reached set. Uses ahash-backed AHashMap/AHashSet for hashing (not SipHash) to minimize per-operation latency. Replaces N serial get_neighbors calls (each O(R) for adjacency) with a single O(R + V) pass.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

names.description: Seed entity names to expand around (nonexistent names are silently skipped)

depth.description: BFS expansion depth (0 returns only seeds, default 1)

name: batch_get_entities
description: O(N) batched entity lookup for N names, each resolved via the interned-name → sharded ctrl-byte name table (Swiss-table style, O(1) expected per lookup). Missing names yield null in the corresponding position. Cuts N serial get_entity round-trips (each with its own dispatch + JSON parse + JSON serialize overhead) down to one.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

names.description: Entity names to retrieve (order preserved, null for missing)

name: find_all_paths
description: Exhaustive DFS with backtracking enumerating all simple paths between two entities up to maxDepth hops, capped at maxPaths. Worst-case O(b^d) where b = average branching factor and d = maxDepth; the maxPaths cap prevents combinatorial explosion. Each path is a Vec<String> of entity names inclusive of both endpoints. Unlike find_path (single BFS shortest path), this discovers alternative routes the LLM may not have considered.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

maxDepth.description: Max path length; DFS prunes beyond this bound (default 6, cost grows exponentially)

maxPaths.description: Stop after finding this many paths (default 50, prevents combinatorial explosion)

name: entity_exists
description: Check whether each named entity exists, WITHOUT fetching its observations. Returns an array of booleans parallel to the input names. Use this for cheap de-duplication or presence checks before create/update — far lighter than get_entity/open_nodes, which transfer full records.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

names.description: Entity names to test for existence

name: degree
description: Return the number of relations incident to an entity in the given direction, without enumerating the neighbors. Transfers only an integer — use it to decide whether to paginate a high-degree hub before calling get_neighbors.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to select for this call. Omission uses the caller's saved default; an explicit ID never changes that default.

name.description: The entity whose degree to count

name: create_workspace
description: Create a new workspace with the caller as owner. The first workspace a caller creates becomes its saved default; a later one never replaces it. The graph file is registered together with the ownership row.

name.description: The display name of the workspace

visibility.description: Private graphs serve only owners and grantees; public graphs are readable by any authenticated identity

name: list_workspaces
description: List the workspaces the caller can access: owned, granted, and public graphs. Private graphs of other callers never appear. Sorted by immutable workspace ID; the cursor is opaque.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page

name: get_workspace
description: Return one workspace the caller can access, with the caller's role and default flag. Only the owner sees the owner identity.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

name: set_workspace_visibility
description: Change a workspace's visibility. Only the owner may change it; a public-to-private transition clears the defaults of callers without a grant.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

name: list_workspace_grants
description: List the access grants of a workspace the caller owns.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

name: grant_workspace_access
description: Grant reader or writer access to a registered identity. Only the owner may grant; the owner's own access cannot be replaced by a grant.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

principalId.description: A registered human or machine identity

role.description: reader may read; writer may read and write

name: revoke_workspace_access
description: Revoke a grant. Only the owner may revoke, and the owner cannot revoke their own ownership. A revoked grant clears the caller's default in the same transaction.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

principalId.description: The identity whose grant is removed

name: set_default_workspace
description: Save the caller's default workspace. Omitted workspaceId on later graph, vector and webhook calls selects it. An explicit workspaceId never changes the default.

workspaceId.description: The immutable workspace ID

name: create_machine_account
description: Create a machine credential with tool-category scopes. The token appears exactly once in the result; the registry keeps only its digest. Requires an admin human or trusted local stdio.

name.description: A display name for the account

scopes.description: Tool-category scopes the credential may use (graph-read, graph-write, vectors, code). Never admin.

name: list_machine_accounts
description: List machine accounts and their scopes and revocation state. Credentials are never returned. Requires an admin human or trusted local stdio.

name: revoke_machine_account
description: Revoke a machine credential; it stops authenticating on the next request. Revoking clears the account's grants and default. Requires an admin human or trusted local stdio.

name: begin_attachment_upload
description: Reserve space for a file on a live workspace entity. Send file bytes with ordered calls to append_attachment_chunk, then finish the upload.

workspaceId.description: Selected workspace. Omit only if the saved default selects the file's graph.

entityName.description: Name of the live parent entity

filename.description: Non-empty filename, unique on this entity

mime.description: Allowed MIME type such as text/plain or application/pdf

expectedBytes.description: File size in raw bytes; the default limit is 52,428,800

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the complete file

name: append_attachment_chunk
description: Append at most 1,048,576 decoded bytes to an upload. Indexes start at zero. An exact replay of the previous chunk is safe.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds this upload session

uploadId.description: Upload session ID returned by begin_attachment_upload

content.description: Base64 for at most 1,048,576 raw bytes

name: finish_attachment_upload
description: Check file size and SHA-256, store the file, and queue extraction. Returns the same attachment on replay.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds this upload session

uploadId.description: Upload session ID returned by begin_attachment_upload

name: cancel_attachment_upload
description: Remove an upload session and its uncommitted bytes to release its reserved space.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds this upload session

uploadId.description: Upload session ID returned by begin_attachment_upload

name: list_attachments
description: List attachment metadata for one live entity. File bytes are not returned.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds the entity

entityName.description: Name of the live parent entity

name: get_attachment
description: Read one attachment's metadata and parent name without reading its file bytes.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds the attachment

name: read_attachment_chunk
description: Read at most 1,048,576 file bytes as base64. Offsets count raw bytes.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds the attachment

length.description: Maximum raw bytes in this response

name: get_attachment_page
description: Read up to 4,096 Unicode scalar characters of stored text from one page. Pages start at one.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds the attachment

offset.description: Starting Unicode scalar offset; defaults to zero

maxChars.description: Maximum Unicode scalar characters; defaults to 4,096

name: delete_attachment
description: Delete an attachment, its text, its upload data, and its vector data from the selected graph.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that holds the attachment
